NONE: C1 a solid object with a square base and four triangular sides that form a point at the top
角錐；金字塔
› a pile of things that has the shape of a pyramid
擺成金字塔形的一堆東西
› a group of ancient pyramid-shaped structures built in Egypt as tombs (= places to bury people) for the Pharaohs (= kings of Ancient Egypt)
（古埃及為埋葬法老修建的）金字塔

example: The acrobats formed a pyramid by standing on each other's shoulders.
雜技演員一個站上另一個的肩膀表演疊羅漢。
figurative Many organizations have a pyramid structure (= there are fewer people at the top levels of them than there are at the bottom).
許多團體呈現金字塔式的組織結構。

NONE: › a way of deceiving investors (= people giving money to a company hoping to get more back) in which money that a company receives from new customers is not invested to their advantage, but is used instead to pay debts owed to existing customers
金字塔型投資（公司從新客戶處籌集資金並非是為了他們的利益投資，而是用於清還舊帳的一種欺騙投資者的方式）；老鼠會
› in business, the act of someone buying the right to sell a company's goods, and then selling the goods to other people. These people then sell the goods to other people.
金字塔型銷售術；傳銷；老鼠會
› mathematics, medical shaped like a pyramid
金子塔狀的
› medical relating to the path of groups of nerve fibres in the brain called the pyramidal tract
（神經）錐體束的
› a small, triangular muscle in the front of the abdomen
錐狀肌
› a large pile of wood on which a dead body is burned in some parts of the world
火葬堆

example: A traditional Hindu custom used to involve widows burning themselves alive on their husbands' funeral pyres.
印度過去有一個傳統習俗，就是將寡婦在丈夫的火葬堆上活活燒死殉葬。

NONE: › a brand name for a type of glass that does not break when it is heated, used for making containers for cooking
耐熱玻璃（用於製造炊具）
› a shiny, yellow mineral containing iron and sulphur, that looks like gold but is not valuable
硫化礦，黃鐵礦（一種有光澤的黃色礦物，含硫和一種金屬，通常是鐵）
› a mental illness in which a person feels a strong wish to start fires
縱火狂，放火癖
› someone who suffers from pyromania
縱火狂
› a public show of fireworks
焰火，煙火表演
› a show of great skill, especially by a musician or someone giving a speech
（尤指音樂家或演講者）出神入化的表演，出色的表現

example: His verbal pyrotechnics could hold an audience spellbound.
他出色的口才能迷倒聽眾。

NONE: › a victory that is not worth winning because the winner has lost so much in winning it
以極大代價換取的勝利，得不償失的勝利

example: She won the court case, but it was a Pyrrhic victory because she had to pay so much in legal fees.
她贏了這場官司，但得不償失，因為她得支付高額訴訟費。
